response.text: Payment journals use `SRC_REF = PAY-<id>`, and I need to confirm how they link to payments. I'll also check the credit-memo and orphan-account journals.

arguments.sql:
SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."POST_DT", p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT min("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%') OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (1361,1894,2485)
UNION ALL SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."POST_DT", NULL, i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "APINVH" i USING ("JRNL_NO") WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (802, 620) OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (1361,1894) OR i."INV_AMT"=10353.39

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE 'PAY-'||p."PAY_ID"=h."SRC_REF")) pay_jrnl_orphan, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID")) pay_no_jrnl, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD"='2000' WHERE l."CR_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT") inv_vs_cr_diff, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND h."SRC_CD"='AP')) inv_jrnl_not_ap, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING ("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT") postdt_ne_invdt, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "VEND_CD"<>rpad(trim("VEND_CD"),8)) vend_pad_issue, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "MEMO" ~* '(ignore|instruction|assistant|system|select |drop )') suspicious_memo
